question: W-R22 found naive single past-second-difference online prediction worse under sensor noise. Can a preregistered median-of-three recent curvature estimator suppress noise while adapting to the new post-tick8 curvature regime, without external model calls or heldout tuning?
hypothesis: The median of the last three *already observed* signed circular second differences may improve late-regime one-step circular MAE over both naive online curvature and the development-trained frozen curvature, but may adapt too slowly under a sharp regime shift.
generator: EXACT W-R22 synthetic 16-tick raw first-channel generator. Development seeds88..91 have quadratic dynamics and actual 3-level jitter, heldout92..95 introduce 2*max(0,t-8)^2 after tick8 and five-level time-varying jitter; 9 entities/seed. No future heldout observations used for prediction or training.
arms: development-trained one-scalar frozen curvature (median over development second differences)
naive online one-step curvature from the immediately preceding observed three ticks
ROBUST online median of three most recent *available* signed curvature observations; at early ticks use median of available 1-2 or development scalar when none, frozen before first-use
budget: All predictors receive identical same five-tick causal context, at most one frozen learned scalar d2, no extra model inference or future data; robust predictor evaluates up to three scalar historical signed differences with O(1) computation and no persistent learned weights. Track operations separately, no capacity increase hidden.
primary: Per-seed full, prechange t2..8 and postchange t9..15 circular MAE over all 9x14 targets; ROBUST_ONLINE_TRANSFER if median postchange <=0.9*frozen postchange, <=naive postchange, and improvement in >=3/4 heldout seeds. PARTIAL if median postchange <frozen but fails other criteria. NEGATIVE otherwise; preserve all outcomes.
safeguards: Pinned exact source identities, new disjoint seeds, jitter cardinality asserts, prerecorded thresholds/splits before first-use, no first-use retries, one full Go repo regression, no accepted-ref mutation or capacity inflation.
claim_limit: Synthetic time-series autoregression with causal observation-only online updates, not semantic reasoning or real-world transfer.
